distinct_body: The Founders Organization has its own journey, separate from The .LLab™ Products. It exists because founders face a specific problem: significant talent and momentum, without the leadership infrastructure required to make it durable.
phases_eyebrow: The four-phase model, applied to founders

phases.title: Foundations
phases.description: Understanding the founder — purpose, potential, values, identity — before touching the org chart.

phases.title: Infrastructure Planning & Management
phases.description: Determining what infrastructure the enterprise actually needs, and how the pieces connect.

phases.title: Internal Operating Systems
phases.description: Structures, decision pathways, and accountability that outlast any one hire.

phases.title: Preservation
phases.description: An organization that can grow, transfer, and run — beyond the founder, into legacy.

apply_headline: Ready to build the infrastructure behind your enterprise?
apply_body: The introductory Founders offer funds the collaboration behind your enterprise — hands-on infrastructure work with The Co.LLab™ while the founding rate is still open.

Everything in Founder, plus priority infrastructure planning and the deepest founding-rate lock-in available — the top tier of the introductory offer.
